title: Early-Lock Credit on the Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee
content:
A buyer who requests a Builder Extended Rate Lock soon after signing the purchase agreement receives a credit on the upfront fee percent.

**Rule.** The lock lead is the calendar days from the Home Purchase Agreement's contract date to the lock request date. A lock lead of 7 days or fewer takes 0.125 percentage points off the upfront fee percent; a lock lead above 7 days up to 30 days takes 0.0625 percentage points off; a longer lead takes nothing off. The points are taken off the upfront fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Lock lead | Off the upfront fee percent |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 days | 0.125 percentage points |
| 8 to 30 days | 0.0625 percentage points |
| 31 days or more | nothing |

The contract date is the date the buyer signed, read from the Home Purchase Agreement record; the request date is read from the lock record.

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates, contract date 1 April)

| Lock request date | Lead | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 8 April | 7 | 0.125 |
| 9 April | 8 | 0.0625 |
| 1 May | 30 | 0.0625 |
| 2 May | 31 | nothing |

Hypothetical effect: an upfront fee percent of 0.500 with a lead of 5 days becomes 0.375.
